name: Haa Bing
source:
Born in Suzhou.
She and Yen were childhood friends who both studied dance at the Beijing Dance Academy, and came to Hong Kong together to teach dance classes.
Yen doesn't have a knack for choosing men, and she kept a close watch on him.
During Yen's divorce from Breeze, she compared him to her own husband and blamed him for it, and she became estranged from Yen for a while.
Three years ago, when Yen was abducted by the Over Heaven society, Lai interviewed her.
Therefore, when Yen went missing for the second time, she voluntarily consulted Lai.
